basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Project Management Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Assistant - Project Management post in the DRDO-sponsored project "Design of Broadband and Directive Circular Antenna Array for Long-Range Communication with Unmanned Underwater Robots". The consolidated pay is up to Rs. 20,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, and the essential qualification is a Bachelors degree in the appropriate discipline.
